createsummary.description: Summarize the current session: what was done, files changed, decisions made, and the current state. Writes to session_log/LATEST.md.
createsummary.template: Summarize this entire session. Review ALL file changes (reads, writes, edits) and any bash commands executed or errors encountered. Write a comprehensive summary to session_log/LATEST.md (overwrite). Include: date, what was built/changed, every file created or modified, key decisions made, bugs fixed, errors encountered, known issues, and what to continue with next. Use markdown with sections.
